title: My BMW app and in-vehicle apps
summary: Feedback on the My BMW app and in-vehicle apps is dominated by vague or procedural mentions, with clear praise focused on liking the app experience and clear complaints focused on access difficulty and update-related issues.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the My BMW app and available on-screen apps as enjoyable and excellent to use.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe difficulty accessing the app due to a complicated password and issues tied to app or services updates in connection with other problems.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mostly mention app categories, update instructions, missing applications, retry messages, or customization requests without enough context to assign clear sentiment.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, which limits confidence about specific customer attitudes.
Several examples are brief labels or service instructions rather than full evaluative feedback.
The topic includes both mobile app comments and in-vehicle apps/services references, which may mix related but distinct subjects.
